def: to be translucent; figuratively, to be innocent
kjv: be (make) clean, cleanse, be clear, count pure.

words.word: or how can he be clean

occurrences.text: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
words: or how can he be clean

occurrences.text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
